meta.title: The Founding Partner program — Mobilcab
meta.description: Join the Founding Partner list during launch: first 2 months free on your chosen plan when paid plans launch (Cut list for less than the cost of a single sheet of melamine board per month). Enrollment closes at subscription launch. Apply in the app.

hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool furniture workshops actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for furniture makers to build it with us. Join free from the app (only your name and email are required; workshop name and company ID are optional — no document upload); at subscription launch (first paid plan: Cut list, less than the cost of a single sheet of melamine board per month), people on the list get **the first 2 months free** on their chosen plan. Enrollment closes when paid plans launch. Anyone who joins later pays full price. Cut list on Free is available to everyone — Founding Partner is not the access gate.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: Free to join
items.body: You pay nothing to sign up. You're not obliged to buy when paid plans launch. Enrollment closes at subscription launch.

items.title: First 2 months free
items.body: At subscription launch, you get the first 2 months free on the Cut list plan (less than the cost of a single sheet of melamine board per month) or on higher plans that are available. Enrollment closes when paid plans launch — anyone who joins later pays the standard price.

items.title: Your ideas on the development list
items.body: What you tell us is missing in the workshop goes onto a list of possible app developments. We build them when more people in the community want them — not just one workshop.

items.title: Your name on the list
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Direct contact
items.body: You talk with the founders (and the other Founding Partners). We notify you personally at subscription launch, with the standard price and your 2 free months.

proof.title: What the first Founding Partners say

team.title: Who builds Mobilcab
team.body: Hi! We're building Mobilcab in Romania with a simple goal: replace cut-list spreadsheets and heavy CAD with a fast tool that runs in the browser. As a Founding Partner, you talk to us directly, tell us what's missing in the workshop, and influence the order we ship new features.

next.title: What happens after you apply
steps: You submit the request in the app in about 15 seconds (workshop name and company ID are optional). We confirm your place on the list quickly — no documents to upload.
You use the app like everyone else — full Cut list on Free, with unlimited cut-list export during the launch period.

At subscription launch, we contact you with the standard price and the first 2 months free on your chosen plan. Founding Partner enrollment closes. Anyone who subscribes later, without a place on the list, pays full price.

apply.title: Apply in the app
apply.body: Founding Partner requests are submitted from your free account in the app — the workshop name and company ID are optional, and there are no documents to upload.
apply.cta: Open the app and request a spot
